items.title: Buddy Burns Interview, 1958-08-14
items.q: Willa and Josephine, well that's right, well Jackson the next year, yeah, yeah. So she built a dance hall there.

ctx.x: Lawn parties, huh? Yeah, that's right.

Well it was a dance hall, you know, that first was lawn parties, years ago, and then she made a dance hall. She did? Yeah, regular big dance hall. Did she build it out in their yard? Build it, build it in that big vacant place where we used to have the, she used to have the lawn parties. Where was that? That was on, on, let's see, on Woola. On Woola and, Woola and Jackson, Jackson Woola. I don't think it was, Jackson Clare or Jackson Woola? Josephine somebody told me it was. Josephine, well between Josephine and…
Did they have them every week or night or when?
